_meta.description: Per-file provenance vs HestiaCP. A file listed with source_type 'eigenbau' is HestiaRE-native. Recompute is a manual, occasional job (when we cherry-pick or reintegrate from upstream); numbers are a snapshot at each file's upstream_ref + measured_at, not live.
_meta.divergence_method: churn = (added+removed)/(upstream_lines+our_lines)*100, from `git diff --numstat` between the two blobs. RAW: includes the mechanical v-*->h-* rename + path churn (install/->share/, CONF_DIR), so it OVERSTATES semantic divergence. Triage, not truth.

source_type_values.verbatim: Near-unchanged upstream file (auto-seeded when churn <=3%; only rename/path shims).
source_type_values.derived: Reimplemented/diverged from upstream on purpose (auto-seeded when churn >3%).
source_type_values.cherry-pick: Isolated upstream bugfix taken directly. Manual promotion - not auto-detectable from churn.
source_type_values.eigenbau: HestiaRE-native, no upstream counterpart. May carry an inspiration note.

_meta.symlink_policy: v-* aliases are committed symlinks (upstream cherry-pick ease); they are NOT listed here - only real files carry provenance.
